description: Intent i009 (rx-pull-stale-hdr, snapshot s03) complete. Searched only snapshots/s03: a function-span scanner over net/ and drivers/ produced 234 capture-before-pull chains; twelve candidates triaged, strongest deep-read line-by-line. FINDING 1 (high): s03:net/mac80211/rx.c:3321-3336, ieee80211_rx_h_data TDLS block — untrusted source is a remote 802.11 peer's frame converted to 802.3 (h_proto == ETH_P_TDLS at 3322-3323); tf captured as a cast of rx->skb->data at 3324; pskb_may_pull(rx->skb, offsetof(struct ieee80211_tdls_data, u)) at 3326-3327 can __pskb_pull_tail -> pskb_expand_head and free skb->head for a cloned/non-linear RX skb; because the pull is the left operand of &&, lines 3328-3330 dereference the stale tf (tf->payload_type, tf->category, tf->action_code) with no refetch, gating queueing of the frame into the interface TDLS channel-switch worker — exact pep_get_sb() shape on a receive-path parser (KASAN-detectable slab UAF read). FINDING 2 (medium): s03:net/mac80211/tdls.c:2006-2032, ieee80211_process_tdls_channel_switch worker consuming RX-queued TDLS skbs — tf captured at 2010, skb_linearize(skb) at 2020 can free/replace the head, stale tf->action_code read at 2026 dispatches the TDLS channel-switch state machine; overlaps the site reported for s03 by sibling tx-cow intent i010/f002 but is on the RX-originated queue per this branch's definition. Seed itself (net/phonet/pep.c:55) confirmed still unpatched in s03 (baseline, reported by sibling i011). Safe in s03 with concrete line evidence: br_multicast.c:2869/3616 (scalar copy-out before the attacker-length pull plus explicit 'reload grec' at 2921; fresh ipv6_hdr(skb) accessor at 3616 — the fixed variants unlike s02/s05), ip6_output.c:436 ip6_forward_proxy_check (hdr refetched at 471 after the 451 pull), psp_main.c:345 (psph refetched at 362, iph/uh read pre-pull), pppoe.c:1191 (no relocating call before use; gso twin captures after its pull). udp_offload.c:181 was not re-raised (reported by s03 gro intent i019/f017). Bounded negative evidence: all findings are static hypotheses requiring a cloned/non-linear skb at the flagged pull (driver RX/GRO dependent), not dynamically reproduced; remaining limitations include unresolved scanner chains not line-verified in s03 (igmp.c:963, ip_input.c:365, ovs flow.c:449, esp4/esp6 esph, nf_nat_proto, ip6_tunnel, seg6_local, rpl_iptunnel, calipso, ila, lwt_bpf, ipmr, llc, icmp6, plus pattern-screened drivers/ chains and some multi-function scanner spans); interprocedural callee-pull cases are deferred to intent i024. Artifact: agent-state/findings/i009.json (version 1, snapshots_checked=["s03"], 2 findings, 12 candidates, limitations list), checkpoint updated.
